item.title: 📰 Significant global shifts in cryptocurrency regulation are scheduled to take effect on January 1, ...
item.description: 📰 Significant global shifts in cryptocurrency regulation are scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2026. The European Union is implementing a directive that mandates crypto exchanges to report user and transaction information to national tax authorities. In the United Kingdom, crypto exchanges will be required to submit detailed user transaction reports to tax authorities. Meanwhile, Uzbekistan is establishing a special framework to permit stablecoin payments, and Turkmenistan is legalizing mining and crypto exchanges through its new "Virtual Assets Law." Additionally, the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework will come into effect.
